articles.description: Vladimir Putin has signed a decree increasing Russia's armed forces to 2,441,630 personnel, the fourth such increase this year.

articles.title: Mother rescued in remote PNG after premature triplets die before help arrives
articles.description: A young mother who gave birth to triplets in a remote part of Papua New Guinea was successfully evacuated, but all three of her babies died before help could reach them.

articles.title: Tanzania Lifts Extra Visa Restrictions on Nigerians, Ends 2
articles.description: Tanzania has removed Nigeria from its Referred Visa Category, ending stricter entry checks and allowing Nigerians to use standard visa procedures.

articles.title: Shooting leaves 4 dead, 4 wounded in Caribbean tourism destination
